translations.web: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
translations.bsb: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask. Only give me the girl as my wife!”
translations.kjv: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
translations.asv: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
